topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for cell transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and mutation mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer mutations and demonstrate their molecular mechanisms through cell cycle regulators and p53.

topics.label: Types and mechanisms of genetic instability in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how failures in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multistep tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the stepwise model of cancer progression and show how inherited mutations accelerate tumor development.
